items.title: Bitcoin surges above $68,000, liquidating $1.4 billion shorts as Treasury buybacks boost risk appetite
items.summary: BTC rose about 6% while ether, solana and crypto stocks climbed after the Treasury doubled the size of its bond buybacks.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin ETFs draw $517 million, ether pulls $189 million in biggest inflows in months
items.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs pulled in $517 million and ether funds $189 million on Aug. 19, the strongest daily hauls in months, as a broad rally torched $2.7 billion in bearish bets.

items.title: Trader who made $49 million shorting crypto lost $24 million on ether in 12 seconds
items.summary: The Hyperliquid wallet known as pension-usdt.eth was forced out of a 50,000 ETH short as ether surged, with five liquidation orders helping push the price higher during the unwind.

items.title: Bearish crypto bets lose record $2.7 billion as bitcoin surges toward $70,000
items.summary: Traders betting against crypto lost $2.74 billion in a day, more than the short side of the October 2025 crash that remains the biggest liquidation event in the market's history.

items.title: Ether jumps 18% to $2,250 as bitcoin tops $69,000 in broad crypto rally
items.summary: Every major except tron posted double-digit weekly gains, with nearly $1.4 billion of short positions wiped out after the Treasury doubled its bond buybacks.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: HYPE jumps 20% as Trump signals legal US path for Hyperliquid
items.summary: HYPE reached $72 after Trump said the CFTC was pursuing compliant US access for Hyperliquid, though no formal regulatory plan has been released.

items.title: Rushed CLARITY Act vote could set legislation back, Gallego warns
items.summary: Gallego said the White House has not provided point-by-point feedback on a bipartisan ethics proposal as a September vote approaches.

items.title: Bitcoin briefly hits $70,000 for the first time since June. Here is why
items.summary: The largest crypto asset rose more than 7% on Wednesday after several catalysts sent crypto-related assets higher.

items.title: HYPE jumps 11% as Trump says CFTC is working to bring Hyperliquid to U.S.
items.summary: During a White House meeting Wednesday, President Donald Trump said CFTC Chair Mike Selig is working to bring the perpetual futures platform into the U.S. under federal rules.

items.title: Trump pushes Congress to move on Clarity Act during White House crypto event
items.summary: The CEOs from companies across several tech-forward sectors met with the president in advance of this week's first Innovation Advisory Committee at the CFTC.

items.title: Crypto campaign fund Fairshake faces $2 million setback in Florida primaries
items.summary: In a race that drew criticism to crypto's leading political action committee for featuring fake headlines in ads, Fairshake's expensive effort fell short.

items.title: Bitcoin nears key technical breakout that could propel prices to $76,000
items.summary: Bitcoin is close to forming a pattern that analysts say could signal prices rising to as high as $76,000.

items.title: Coinbase, Circle and Bullish jump as Clarity Act proponents express optimism about bill
items.summary: COIN and BLSH rose about 8% and CRCL gained nearly 10% ahead of a key procedural vote scheduled for Sept. 15.

items.title: AI could supercharge crypto but there’s a catch, Fidelity Digital Assets says
items.summary: AI agents could boost crypto activity, but much of the value may bypass blockchains and their tokens.

items.title: HSBC, Standard Chartered execute first live banking transaction on Swift’s 24/7 ledger
items.summary: The cross-border transaction is Swift’s first in a pilot project as it tests settlement in its push to remain relevant as stablecoins and tokenized deposits become widely used worldwide.

items.title: Cantor opens Kalshi prediction markets to thousands of institutional clients
items.summary: The investment bank will help its roughly 3,000 institutional clients execute large block trades in event contracts.

items.title: Beyond crypto funding rates: Ethena diversifies USDe backing with $1 billion FalconX facility
items.summary: The warehouse facility gives Ethena another source of returns for the assets backing USDe while channeling onchain capital into overcollateralized institutional loans.

items.summary: The American Bankers Association seeks to strengthen the Clarity Act, not kill it, argues Rob Nichols, president and CEO of the ABA.
